acceptance.title: Create/open/save project; Unicode name and spaced path; stable UUID/revision and exact rational settings survive round trip.
Command transactions/undo/redo/stale revision; illegal operation changes no state; undo group restores exact structure.
Schema migration/invalid/newer document; migration backup exists, corrupt document rejected, unknown extension metadata preserved.
Headless/native GPU frame; analytic color/alpha oracle, row stride, first frame initialized, no double transfer encoding.
Resize/minimize/fullscreen/close/reopen; no stale surface use, leaked targets or zero-size crash.
Native output+editor preview+second consumer; frame IDs agree, simulation step count unchanged by consumers.
Import/play/seek real file with B frames/rotation/VFR; displayed PTS follows selected source frame rule; stale seek discarded.
Play audio+video flash/impulse, loop and frame-step; error<=one project frame+5ms after known device latency compensation.
First PNG+WAV/available MP4 export; exact600 frames/480000 samples for10s60fps fixture; reimport duration/metadata validated.
Graph type/cycle/missing-input validation; clear exact node/port error; temporal cycle exception only explicit pair.
Branched/masked/composited graph; output pixel oracle and no scratch-resource read/write alias.
Graph add/connect/group/copy/paste/undo; new IDs and preserved internal connections, no dangling references.
Bad shader/edit; current document retains edit/error, last valid runtime frame graph remains usable, fix activates new version.
Silence/bass/sine/treble analysis; bands/window normalization/onset time match numeric expectations.
Audio callback/rings/device loss; no blocking/alloc/network in callback, overruns counted and silence on underflow.
Keyframes/modulation fold/LFO/enum hysteresis/expression; CPU reference values at exact timestamps.
File audio drives visuals in live and offline; features sampled by source timestamp, independent of export render speed.
Trim/split/move/slip/rate/reverse; property tests preserve source mapping and half-open endpoints.
Linked A/V ripple/insert/overwrite/locked track; atomic failure or correct synchronized edits; undo restores.
Transition handles/overlap/clip-track-master-adjustment order; expected image/audio crossfade and masks.
Waveforms/proxies/reverse GOP cache; cancel job, original source retained, same time selection, bounded memory.
Mixer gain/pan/mute/solo/fades/time-stretch; pitch-preserving stretch maintains sine pitch while duration changes.
FX001–FX028 all present, each manifest/algorithm/changed control/transparency/scale/export tested.
FX100–FX123 every named variant implemented with distinguishing behavior; no identity alias masked as variant.
Feedback/echo/delay/freeze; known impulse decay and history count; output rate does not change feedback step cadence.
Seek/checkpoint/warm-up/invalidation; subrange output equals corresponding frames from full render within tolerance.
Generator source clip add/trim/loop/save/load/mask/effect chain; no required source file for procedural node.
All required G001–G028 rows with available IDs; fractal/periodic noise/L-system/automaton invariants and bounded loops.
Field metadata/converters; known constant vector causes expected displacement, incompatible spaces rejected.
SVG safe import/editor; donut hole/gradients/viewBox correct, active/unsupported content reported, no external fetch.
Path draw/follow/morph/repeater; arc-length position and winding correct, checkpoint not needed for analytic motion.
Lottie actual frame seek and color/control changes; fixed t agrees paused/live/export; unsupported features identified.
Image motion G050–G068; transforms/warp/parallax/fragments/sprites with alpha and deterministic controls.
Typography G070–G079; Unicode/shaped cluster animation, glyph holes, correct fallback, Mask/Geometry outputs.
Video/image sequence/sprite retime and animation export; frame order/rate/loop boundaries correct.
SDF analytic sphere/Boolean/normal/depth; correct center ray and finite no-hit; invalid tree rejected.
Metaball/deformation/material animated through effects; opacity/Depth/Normal coherent; ray-step cap maintained.
SDF mesh conversion/cancel/GLB export; finite bounds, normals, expected connected surface; job memory capped.
Mesh primitive/scene/camera/light coordinates; expected marker positions, depth occlusion, transparent compositing.
Imported glTF skin/morph/PBR and PLY point cloud; actual time-varying geometry/material, missing assets reported.
G090–G107 terrain/instances/voxels/ocean/volumes; count/resource limits, no hidden infinite generation.
Particle counts/IDs/birth/death at30/60/120Hz presentation; identical simulation schedule and reset.
Image/text/path/mesh emitters, morph/trails/collision; known samples map correctly, no capacity out-of-bounds.
Boids/slime/field events; bounded neighbor scan, event cap and state replay, no unbounded per-particle trail.
Rigid body/joint/pendulum; free-fall reference tolerance, stable contacts, deterministic reset/checkpoint.
Cloth/jelly constraints; pinned points remain fixed, finite volume/positions, no explosion under valid settings.
Fluids/water/sand/reaction; projection reduces divergence, stable finite field, material rules and impulses correct.
Simulation subrange seek/export/control replay equals full sequence; changes invalidate dependent checkpoints.
OSC actual UDP encode/decode/all declared types; scheduled bundle order, native/normalized routes and learn.
OSC malformed/rate limit/duplicate trigger/feedback loop; app responsive, no unauthorized file or shell action.
MIDI real device or explicit unavailable; notes/CC/bend/pressure/MPE/clock/pickup correct and reconnects.
Recorded controls/CSV/JSON/network replay; identical time-mapped data offline; unrecorded live source rejected for export.
Event sequencer/rhythm/expressions/interaction record; deterministic quantization/random-on-beat, no eval escape.
Actual webcam capture modes/orientation/timestamps; permission and disconnect/reconnect handled.
Actual screen/display/window/region/cursor capture; crop/DPI/window resize correct and self-capture exclusion works.
Actual microphone and system-loopback; no dummy stream, output-device change and permission recovery.
Live source→take→offline export; captured timestamps align audio/video and survive relink.
Actual Windows Spout send/receive with independent sender/consumer; resize/alpha/adapter behavior recorded.
Actual macOS Syphon send/receive and loss/reconnect; ownership and orientation correct.
Actual NDI official SDK/runtime send/receive loopback; frame/audio release counts, stride/timestamps, missing-runtime behavior.
Max `.maxpat` structural checks plus real OSC bytes interoperate; multiple instances, stale release, sequence epochs.
Real packaged `.amxd` in Live; audio/MIDI unchanged through pass-through, macros automate, Set reopen restores.
Max/conditional Link transport; single master, seek/loop/start-stop behavior, tempo phase aligned, no control-as-audio confusion.
Live workspace/macros/scene recall/crossfade/quantize/panic; compile-ahead, fixed state stepping, responsive editor.
Fullscreen and multiple outputs at chosen rate/size; settings persist, consumer failure does not stop preview.
Live recording with controls/audio; reimported content matches recorded response, overload policy and CFR gap handling measured.
Export codec matrix and alpha; real available H.264/HEVC/ProRes/GIF/image-sequence/WAV encoders exercised, unsupported disabled accurately.
Export frozen revision while editing; original snapshot used, concurrent live state undisturbed, no incomplete renamed output.
Cancel/disk-full/encoder failure/restart/sequence resume; no lost originals, safe job-owned temp cleanup, errors actionable.
Export fractional fps/VFR/odd size/color/alpha/range; DTS/PTS monotonic, frame/sample counts and output tags correct.
Autosave and forced crash recovery on disposable project; last saved and recovered revisions both available and valid.
Missing media/relink/collect project; ambiguity resolved visibly, originals preserved, relative portable project opens offline.
FFI close/reopen/exit/GPU loss/shader error/disconnect injection; no crashes in supported recovery cases, no dangling workers.
Diagnostics/redaction/settings/capability state; no secrets/media payloads in report, no default telemetry/network dependency.
Conditional actual vision inference; known landmarks/mask/depth and stale/cancel states; exact model/runtime hashes.
Conditional external sketch/runtime source; explicit time render repeats or live-only state recorded; worker crash isolated.
Conditional model/source absent; preserved editable node, actionable dependency error, never fake successful output.
Browser WebGPU harness vs native shader ABI/fixtures; correct uniform packing and documented image tolerance.
Benchmarks below on real GPU with exact settings; measured frame times/queues/memory/latency, no assumed hardware results.
UI keyboard/DPI/focus/drag undo/text input/accessibility; main journey can be completed without lost data or hidden focus.
Soak30min then2h; stable cache budgets/queue depths and no drift/leaks/crash under repeated edits and scene switches.
Windows installer clean standard-user/offline launch, DLL/resources found without dev PATH, uninstall preserves user projects.
macOS arm64 packaged app clean launch, dylibs/rpaths/permissions and file dialogs work; exact signing status reported.
macOS x64 packaged app native run or actual supported runner; architecture/build alone is not runtime verification.
Examples/docs/requirements/artifact hashes/license records reconcile; every advertised workflow reproduces on available host.
